description: Boards of the multi-board climbing env (tasks/climbing/multi_board.py): one level 1 board (curriculum level 0, the easiest) and level 2 boards. Level 2 seeds: the longest (partial) climbs rock-climbing-workshop's planner finds and its trajectory optimiser solves; the partial climbs are trained on as they are, boards whose climb fails are left out. Wall JSON boards: boards/walls/<wall>.json (from rock-climbing-workshop data/walls; gen_l3_s* are level 3 walls in the level 2 group). Motions: src/mjlab_microban/motion/<motion>, made by scripts/make_multi_board_motions.py.
